name: Farringford
accommodation: Self-catering cottages in the Alfred Cottages and Stable Cottages groups
suitableFor: Families and groups wanting self-catering on a historic estate
beachAccess: On Bedbury Lane, Freshwater Bay, next to the West Wight coastline
overview: Farringford is the historic estate on Bedbury Lane above Freshwater Bay, bordering the protected West Wight coastline. It lets two groups of self-catering cottages, the Alfred Cottages and the Stable Cottages, and some of them take dogs. The estate lists surfing among the activities nearby.
surfTripFit: Self-catering within walking distance of Freshwater Bay and a short drive to Compton, and the estate itself points to surfing nearby.
